# Version 4.151.0 (Unreleased)
> **Memory safety and performance**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 (next) continues to ship memory-safety fixes and managed-code performance improvements on the 4.151.x line.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Native use-after-free in `SKRegion.SpanIterator` fixed** — The underlying `SKRegion` was not kept alive during iteration, causing intermittent use-after-free crashes. The region is now rooted for the lifetime of the iterator. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355))
- **Native use-after-free in `SKPixmap.ExtractSubset` and `With*` fixed** — The pixel-data source was not rooted across calls to `ExtractSubset` and the `With*` helper methods, leading to potential memory corruption. ([#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558))

## API Surface

- **Binding generation made deterministic across platforms** — The binding generator now produces identical output regardless of host OS, removing spurious diffs in generated files during cross-platform development. ([#4612](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4612))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **`SKData.SaveTo` optimized to avoid the double-buffer copy** — The `SaveTo` path now writes directly from native memory rather than copying through an intermediate buffer. ([#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550))
- **Several managed hot-path improvements** — `GetEncodedText` avoids an intermediate string allocation in the null-terminated path, `SKRuntimeEffectUniforms` pre-sizes its lookup map, and `HandleDictionary` caches the skip-registration reflection check. ([#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498), [#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512), [#4630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4630))

## Platform

- **FreeType font support on Nano Server** — Nano Server, which lacks the Win32 GDI font stack, now falls back to FreeType for font loading and measurement. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))
